failures.injected_rule: When implementing array manipulation logic involving indexing or shape validation, ensure that intermediate operations preserve dimensionality consistency by explicitly checking if axes are dropped (e.g., via `.flatten()` or `squeeze`) and restoring them if subsequent logic expects a specific rank, because mismatched dimensions cause index errors and assertion failures during verification.

rules.rule: When validating code that processes arrays or structured data, always verify the structural type of the returned value (e.g., checking if it is a tuple, list, or numpy array) before asserting on its dimensions or length, because the actual runtime type may differ from the expected primitive collection.

When implementing array manipulation logic involving indexing or shape validation, ensure that intermediate operations preserve dimensionality consistency by explicitly checking if axes are dropped (e.g., via `.flatten()` or `squeeze`) and restoring them if subsequent logic expects a specific rank, because mismatched dimensions cause index errors and assertion failures during verification.
